description: This file defines the 'DetailActivity' class in an Android project. It handles displaying detailed information about an item, including setting transition names for shared element transitions, loading images with Picasso, and managing transition event listeners to load full-size images after transition completion.

classes.name: DetailActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity that displays detailed information about an item, supports shared element transitions, and loads images asynchronously with Picasso.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up transition names, retrieves item data, and initiates view content loading.

methods.name: loadItem
methods.description: Populates the UI with item data, manages image loading based on transition animation status.

methods.name: loadThumbnail
methods.description: Loads a thumbnail image into the header ImageView.

methods.name: loadFullSizeImage
methods.description: Loads a full-size image into the header ImageView asynchronously.

methods.name: addTransitionListener
methods.description: Adds a transition listener to detect when the shared element transition ends, to then load the full-size image.
